subject: Urgent: Platform & Runtime headcount escalation + comp band adjustment
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: Platform & Runtime headcount escalation + comp band adjustment

Team —

Quick context: after last week's capacity review and the incident runbook dry-run, the Platform/Runtime roadmap is at immediate risk unless we accelerate two hires and adjust the comp band for the Senior Platform SWE role we posted last month. Summary ask below and attached materials.

Asks:
- Approval to convert 1 open Platform SWE requisition (SWE-III) to Senior Platform SWE (SWE-IV) with a $20k uplift to the posted band (details in the PDF).
- Fast-track an additional headcount (1x Senior Infra Engineer) to cover KV cache/latency work; target start: July 2027.
- Allow recruiting spend to trial an external retained search for the Senior role (estimate $25k).

Rationale (brief):
- Candidate flow at current band is weak; we lost two final-stage candidates to net-new offers 10-15% above our top-of-band in the last 6 weeks.
- Operational risk: prefix cache rework and kernel tuning projects are gating Q3 throughput targets. Backfill timeline using current band pushes delivery into Q4.
- Finance impact is modeled in the attached workbook. Net burn is ~+$120k annualized but prevents what we estimate as a 2x revenue impact if Q3 throughput targets slip.

Attachments: platform-infra-band-proposal-2027Q2.pdf, senior-platform-swe-jd-v2.docx, headcount-impact-model-2027Q2.xlsx

Next steps: Marcus/Neha — can you sign off on the band uplift and the one additional headcount? Marissa — can recruiting start the retained search if approved?

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Platform & Runtime headcount escalation + comp band adjustment

Laura —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the model. I reviewed the PDF and the workbook; the argument on candidate market movement aligns with feedback I heard from other teams. I support converting the open req to SWE-IV with the $20k uplift for one hire.

Open items I need Neha to confirm:
- Net budget impact (Neha: is the +$120k annualized burn covered in Q2 reforecast or do we need to reprioritize hires elsewhere?)
- Any policy implications of using an external retained search for a role we already have posted internally.

Marissa — please prep the revised JD and the outreach plan for Emma/TalentBridge if we get signoff.

If both items check out, I can greenlight the headcount conversion today so recruiting can move.

—Marcus
Director, Runtime & Platform

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Platform & Runtime headcount escalation + comp band adjustment

Marcus/Laura —

I've run the numbers with Finance ops. Short answer: we can absorb the incremental $120k into the Q2 reforecast if we defer one non-critical IC hire in Platform (a junior role) to Q4; model attached (headcount-impact-model-2027Q2.xlsx). Approvals needed from FP&A lead before it shows up in the formal budget, but there's runway.

On retained search: policy allows a one-off retained engagement when time-to-fill materially impacts product delivery. Please include procurement (cc'd external contact below) on the SOW and vendor terms. We should cap fees at 20% of first-year base for the retained search.

Neha
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Platform & Runtime headcount escalation + comp band adjustment

All —

Will do. I updated the JD to reflect the SWE-IV competencies and added the market-competitive comp lines. I can kick off outreach with Emma at TalentBridge immediately once Neha gives us the thumbs-up on budget. Emma has a strong track record for infra/platform hires in this geography; she suggested a 6-week SLT to filled offer if we go retained.

Cc: karen.jensen@morello.com for procurement SOW review.

Attachments: senior-platform-swe-jd-v2.docx

—Marissa
Sr. Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, karen.jensen@morello.com, emma@talentbridge.io
Date: 2027-04-30T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Platform & Runtime headcount escalation + comp band adjustment

Thanks everyone —

Neha: appreciate the runway confirmation. Marcus: please consider this my formal request to convert the req and open the additional headcount. Marissa: proceed with retained search on approval cap terms (20% first-year base).

I'll follow up with the exec summary for the compensation committee and loop Legal if we need an exception memo for the band uplift. Target: offer window in mid-June.

Laura
